description: Selects the language mode for an AOSS Automatic Semantic Enrichment field. The mode maps onto the AOSS-documented language_options parameter and determines the latency / coverage tradeoff: English mode is optimized for English text and per the AWS docs delivers lower P90 search latency than lexical-only search; multilingual mode covers 15 languages (Arabic, Bengali, Chinese, English, Finnish, French, Hindi, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Persian, Russian, Spanish, Swahili, Telugu) but with a higher P90 latency penalty. Choose multilingual only when the indexed column actually mixes languages.

enum.name: ENGLISH
enum.description: English-only enrichment. Maps to AOSS language_options: "english". Recommended for columns whose contents are predominantly English; lower per-query latency than multilingual mode. Per the AWS docs, the sparse model processes the first 8,192 tokens of each document in this mode.

enum.name: MULTI_LINGUAL
enum.description: Multilingual enrichment across the 15 languages AOSS supports. Maps to AOSS language_options: "MULTI-LINGUAL". Use when the column may contain non-English text (cross-language matching, mixed-language corpora). Per the AWS docs, the sparse model processes the first 512 tokens of each document in this mode and adds latency relative to English mode.
